packageRules.description: Label major updates as breaking changes

Approve and automerge non-major updates. platformAutomerge holds a PR until the REQUIRED status checks pass; the ruleset that makes them required (build, test, coverage, web, e2e, agent-config, i18n, linked-issue) was confirmed live before this flag was flipped - see ADR-0011 and #35.

A web dependency PR changes src/web/package.json or its lock file, and feature-coverage counts src/** as behavior-bearing. The PR cites the Playwright-covered claims the bump leaves standing, in the one shape tools/feature-coverage.mjs accepts; the required web and e2e checks re-prove those claims on the same PR, and the dependency category fails if anything but a manifest or lock file changed (ADR-0090, ADR-0111).
prBodyNotes: No .feature scenario needed: dependency — a web package or lock version moved; no application source file changed
Claims preserved: REQ-SUB-001, REQ-SUB-029, REQ-SUB-045, REQ-MOD-003, REQ-MOD-052, REQ-QB-076

packageRules.description: The .NET SDK in global.json is pinned deliberately; never automerge it

Renovate's terraform manager computes .terraform.lock.hcl checksums itself instead of running terraform, and has produced a checksum that did not match the registry's real package (issue #118). Disabled here; .github/workflows/terraform-relock.yml regenerates the lock file with the real terraform binary on a schedule instead, verified by the required infra CI check.
The coverage toolchain, matching its ItemGroup in Directory.Packages.props. reportgenerator lives in .config/dotnet-tools.json but belongs with the collector it consumes.

@vitejs/plugin-react's major version is peer-locked to vite's (6.x requires vite ^8.0.0) — a solo bump of either breaks npm's peer resolution (#119). Move them together, same reasoning as EntityFrameworkCore/Npgsql below.
EF Core and the Npgsql PROVIDER must move together or migrations break. The bare Npgsql driver is a different vendor on its own cadence and is grouped separately.
The bare Npgsql driver, matching its ItemGroup in Directory.Packages.props. Excludes the EF Core provider, which is pinned to EF Core's cadence above.
The development and test S3 server, pinned in docker-compose.yml and tests/Shared/S3Emulator.cs (ADR-0110). One pull request moves both.
